question: Why did the 2014 drugs trial of the singer Tulisa Contostavlos collapse before the jury could decide?
answer: Because the reporter behind the sting was found to have probably lied. Mazher Mahmood of The Sun on Sunday, known as the Fake Sheikh, had posed as a film producer and drawn her into a cocaine deal. His driver's statement had been altered at his urging; in 2016 Mahmood was jailed for 15 months.
move: Whoever builds the trap has reasons to describe the catch generously.
reference: The Guardian, report of Mazher Mahmood's sentencing at the Old Bailey for conspiracy to pervert the course of justice, October 2016
